title: Docs: as of May 2026, the US Commerce Dept. approved sales of 879K+ AI chips to Chinese companies, including entities on the DOD's Chinese military-linked list (CNBC)
summary: CNBC: Docs: as of May 2026, the US Commerce Dept. approved sales of 879K+ AI chips to Chinese companies, including entities on the DOD's Chinese military-linked list — The subagency of the Commerce Department that regulates and enforces exports approved the sale of more than 879,000 AI chips …
